entries.title: 26w46b: Creatures Update sounds
entries.subtitle: Hear the creatures and try the new stamina bar. Back up your worlds first.
bullets: Every creature, weapon, the bow and the shield now has sounds
A Shattered Sky stamina bar, offhand slot and charge indicator
Clearer Mossback and Duskwalker shapes
entries.body:
The creatures are no longer silent. Each one has its own calls, hurt and death sounds and footsteps, and swords, spears, war hammers, daggers, the bow, arrows and the shield all sound when you use them, with subtitles.

The Shattered Sky HUD gets its own stamina bar (gold, hidden when full), an offhand slot beside the hotbar and in the inventory, and a charge indicator for the spear and war hammer that flashes when the attack is ready. Options › Interface adds Stamina bar (Off, When not full, Always), Low stamina sound and Charge indicator.

The Mossback's head now joins its body with a thick neck, and the Duskwalker's long arms reach forward with pale knuckles that drag in front of its feet. Health bars past 8 blocks no longer grow as a creature walks away.

Story: nothing new in the questline yet.

What to test: listen to each creature by day and night, fight with each weapon and the shield, and turn the new HUD options on and off in both themes.

Known issues: the sword sweep looks blocky up close.

Back up worlds before opening them in a snapshot. A 0.5.0 world opened in 0.4.0 warns you; its creatures are kept but don't appear there.

Report bugs: https://github.com/EliteEagle2/BlockCraft/issues/new?template=snapshot-bug.yml

entries.title: 26w46a: the Creatures Update
entries.subtitle: Test the Creatures Update (0.5.0). Back up your worlds first.
bullets: Mossbacks, Rootsnouts, Cloudfleece and Puffwings roam the land
Duskwalkers, Quillbacks, Cragcrawlers and Shardbursts hunt at night
Bow, shield, spear, war hammer, dagger and a new Combat HUD
entries.body:
The world has life. Four animals live in the grasslands and hills, and all of them give meat: the Mossback also gives milk and leather, the Puffwing feathers and eggs, and the Cloudfleece wool you can shear and dye. When night falls or in the dark, Duskwalkers, Quillbacks, Cragcrawlers and Shardbursts come out. Fight them with the new bow and arrows, spear, war hammer and dagger, and block with a shield in your offhand (F swaps hands). Creatures drop loot and XP, and spawn eggs are in the creative inventory. Creatures and weapons are silent for now; their sounds arrive in the next snapshot.

New worlds can turn on Stamina and dodge (Create World › Blockcraft Features): a stamina bar for sprinting and heavy attacks, and a dodge roll when you double-tap a movement key.

Your old worlds: a 0.4.0 world is backed up when you first open it. Animals appear once in land you've already explored, and hostile creatures spawn in the dark, as in a new world. Peaceful removes them. Empty mob spawners in old worlds become Duskwalker spawners.

Story: nothing new in the questline yet; the Anchor guardians come in a later snapshot.

What to test: spend a night outside, fight each creature with each weapon, try the shield and dodge, and open a backed-up 0.4.0 world.

Known issues: the sword sweep looks blocky up close; the Anchor creature spawn eggs do nothing yet.

Back up worlds before opening them in a snapshot. A 0.5.0 world opened in 0.4.0 warns you; its creatures are kept but don't appear there.

Report bugs: https://github.com/EliteEagle2/BlockCraft/issues/new?template=snapshot-bug.yml

entries.title: Blockcraft: Skywright 0.4.0, the World Update
entries.subtitle: Explore new biomes, deeper caves, wind and sky-storms, with a minimap and waypoints.
bullets: 21 biomes, taller mountains, rebuilt caves and deepslate
Weather, fire, wind, sky-storms and meteor craters
A minimap, map (M), waypoints (N) and the six Anchors
entries.body:
The World Update is here. New worlds reach from y -64 to 320, with wide continents, deep oceans, rivers and tall mountains. Below y 0 lies deepslate, and the caves are rebuilt: big caverns, winding tunnels, narrow passages, ravines, underground lakes and lava deep down.

Explore 17 familiar biomes and four rare Shattering biomes: Shardfall Barrens, Windscour Heights, Glimmerwood and Sunken Terraces. Find camps, ruined watchtowers and dungeon rooms with loot, and dozens of new blocks, from new woods and deepslate bricks to snow, ice, cactus and flowers. Leaves left without a tree now decay, never the ones you place.

Rain and snow fall, and lightning can start fires. Wind sways the leaves, drives the clouds and carries dropped items. Sky-storms are rarer and darker: you can't sleep through one, and their lightning turns exposed rock into glowing storm-touched stone, never inside your Hearth's claim. Find your way with the minimap and compass strip: press M for the map, N to add a waypoint and H to hide waypoints in the world.

Story: the six Anchors stand sealed in the world, 1,500 to 3,000 blocks from spawn (/locate anchor finds the nearest, with cheats on). Skywright ruins dot the land, and meteor craters hold meteorite ore; its meteorite burns twice as long as coal.

Worlds from 0.1.0 to 0.3.0 are backed up the first time they open in 0.4.0. They get the new underground below y 0, and the Anchors, ruins and craters appear in land you haven't explored; the new biomes and mountains are in new worlds. Leaves from before 0.4.0 never decay, and fire doesn't spread unless you use /gamerule doFireTick true. Don't play a 0.4.0 world in 0.3.0: if 0.3.0 warns you, choose Cancel or Back up and continue, never Continue anyway.

Since the 26w45a snapshot:
- Swaying vines and plants no longer clip into walls, and cactus no longer has holes
- Smoother motion and less shimmer in the distance; Anti-aliasing and Graphics card in Options › Video
- Strong wind pushes you a little: sneak or stand under a roof to stay put, or turn off Wind push in Options › Accessibility
- In-world waypoint markers only show nearby (set the range in Options › Interface, 64 blocks by default); the compass strip shows the rest and names a waypoint when you look right at it
- New sounds for each material, and chests, doors, trapdoors and fence gates open and close with their own sounds
- Meteor craters start with an impact fire that burns down to embers, spreading only into flammable land
- F3 hides the compass strip, minimap, markers and status effects, and shows the wind in words

Next up: the Creatures Update (0.5.0), with original creatures, new weapons, stamina and dodge.

entries.title: 26w45b: World Update fixes
entries.subtitle: Test the fixes before 0.4.0. Back up your worlds first.
bullets: Smoother motion, wind push, plants that stay out of walls
New material sounds and crater impact fires
Minimap, compass and options fixes in both themes
entries.body:
Also: anti-aliasing and a graphics card line in Options › Video, waypoint markers only show nearby, and cactus has no holes.

What to test: walk in strong wind, listen to blocks and doors, and tell us if the game freezes for a moment during sky-storms or in the new biomes.

entries.title: Blockcraft: Skywright 0.3.0, the Home Update
entries.subtitle: Make a home with the Hearth, then build it with chests, beds, doors, stairs and more.
bullets: The Hearth: claim a home, earn Comfort, get Rested and buy upgrades
Chests, beds, signs, doors, trapdoors, ladders, fences, walls, panes, slabs and stairs
A recipe browser, inventory sorting, quick stack, chest peek and richer tooltips
entries.body:
The Home Update is here. Place a Hearth and right-click it to make it your home. You'll find its recipe in the new recipe browser. Its screen shows your Comfort, which comes from walls and a roof, light, a bed, storage and decoration, and Comfort makes you Rested while you're at home: faster healing and bonus XP. Spend XP levels on three Hearth upgrades: Wider Claim, Whole Home and Warm Glow. Your Hearth is also where you respawn.

Build your home with chests that join into double chests, beds that skip the night and set a backup respawn point, signs you can write on, doors, trapdoors and ladders, fences and gates, walls, glass panes, iron bars, slabs and stairs. Beds are creative-only for now: wool arrives in a later update, and then beds can be crafted in survival.

Find any recipe in the new recipe browser (press R in an inventory or crafting table) and let it fill the grid for you. Sort a chest or your inventory with the Sort button or a middle-click, press G to quick-stack into nearby chests that already hold your items, hold Left Alt to peek into a chest without opening it, and hover food and tools for their stats. Status effects have their own icons, sleeping has its own screen, and short messages now appear above the hotbar. The block outline now follows a block's whole shape.

Story: Skywright tablets, the Anchor stone, Anchor stone bricks, the glyph block and the Anchor door (which no hand can open) are in the creative Skywright tab. Tablets are carved stone you can place and right-click to read the Skywrights' history; break one and it keeps its text. The Hearth's flame is ready to turn teal for each Anchor restored.

Worlds from 0.2.x open in 0.3.0 and are backed up automatically the first time. Don't open a 0.3.0 world in an older version.

Next up: the World Update (0.4.0), with wind, sky-storms, new biomes and rebuilt caves.

entries.title: Snapshot 26w44a: the Home Update begins
entries.subtitle: Try the Hearth, chests, beds, doors and more before 0.3.0. Back up your worlds first.
bullets: The Hearth: claim a home, earn Comfort, get Rested, buy upgrades
Chests, beds, doors, trapdoors, ladders, fences, walls, panes, slabs, stairs and signs
Inventory sorting, quick stack (G) and richer food and tool tooltips
entries.body:
The first test build of the Home Update. Place a Hearth to make a home. Right-click it to see your Comfort, which comes from walls and a roof, light, a bed, storage and decoration. Comfort gives you Rested while you're at home: faster healing and bonus XP. Spend XP levels on three Hearth upgrades: Wider Claim, Whole Home and Warm Glow. New building blocks arrive too: chests that join into double chests, beds in 16 colours (creative only for now: wool arrives in a later update) that skip the night and work as a backup respawn point, doors, trapdoors and ladders, fences, gates, walls, glass panes, iron bars, slabs, stairs and signs (writing on them comes in the next snapshot). Sort a chest with a middle-click on its empty space, press G to quick-stack your items into nearby chests that already hold them, and hover food or tools to see more in their tooltips. You'll also find Skywright tablets and the Anchor blocks in the creative Skywright tab, and status effect icons in the Shattered Sky theme.

What to test: build a small house around a Hearth and watch your Comfort climb as you add a roof, light, a bed, a chest and decoration. Stay home a while to get Rested, sleep in a bed at night (beds are in creative for now), and try buying an upgrade. Place chests side by side, sort them, and quick-stack into them. Try every new block, especially doors, gates, slabs and stairs.

Snapshots can be unstable, so back up your worlds before trying one. The recipe browser, sign editor, sleeping screen and chest peek arrive in the next snapshots.

entries.title: Blockcraft: Skywright 0.2.2
entries.subtitle: The creative inventory joins the Shattered Sky, plus menu fixes.
bullets: Shattered Sky creative inventory with search and item counts
Options text wraps instead of cutting off at large GUI scales
Clearer digits, resource pack tooltips and an orange furnace flame
entries.body: The creative inventory now has the Shattered Sky look: a row of icon tabs with Search first, a search bar (search by name, or try #food or @blockcraft), item counts, a slim scrollbar, and a Survival Inventory tab with your armour, your character and a red Destroy slot. Menus read better at large GUI scales: Options labels, theme names and key binds wrap onto a second line instead of being cut off, and hovering a resource pack shows its full name and description. The digits 5 and 7 no longer look like S and L, the Default pack shows the Skywright icon, the lit furnace flame glows orange, and in the Shattered Sky theme the hotbar and status bars step aside while a container is open. Classic is unchanged apart from the fixes, and your 0.2.1 worlds open as they are. Next up: the Home Update (0.3.0), with the Hearth, chests, beds and much more.

entries.title: Blockcraft: Skywright 0.2.1, the UI Refresh
entries.subtitle: A brand-new look for every menu, inspired by the Shattered Sky.
bullets: Shattered Sky UI theme, with Classic still available
New title screen, world list, options, inventory and HUD
Pixel fonts, smoother menus and Reduce UI Motion
entries.body: Blockcraft is now Blockcraft: Skywright, and every screen has a new look. The Shattered Sky theme gives the title screen, world list, Create New World, options, pause menu, loading screen, inventory, containers, chat and HUD dark night-sky panels, teal Skyshard accents and crisp pixel fonts. The world list can sort, duplicate worlds and open their folders, the title screen has a Continue button for your last world, the loading screen shows tips, and Options has a search bar and categories. Prefer the old look? Switch to the Classic theme in Options: it keeps Java Edition's style, works with Minecraft resource packs, and has every new feature too. Your 0.2.0 worlds open unchanged.

entries.title: Launcher 1.2.1: Play page fix
entries.body: The Play page now fits smaller launcher windows: the news title and patch notes no longer slide under the sidebar. The launcher updates itself to 1.2.1 the next time it starts online.

entries.title: Launcher 1.2.0: Blockcraft: Skywright
entries.subtitle: A new home screen, a Skins page and a new icon.
bullets: New Play page with patch notes and recent news
Skins page; Logs moved into Settings
Two looks: Shattered Sky or Classic (1.1 look)
entries.body: The launcher is renamed Blockcraft: Skywright and gets the new Shattered Sky look: a sidebar with Play, Installations, Skins, Patch Notes and Settings, a Play page with the latest patch notes and recent news, and a centered PLAY button. Prefer the old design? Settings › Look › Classic (1.1 look) brings it back, with every new page included, and both looks have dark and light modes. The app and installers have a new teal Skywright icon. The launcher updates itself to 1.2.0 the next time it starts online.

entries.title: Blockcraft 0.2.0: the Survival Update
entries.subtitle: Tools, ores, hunger, armor, furnaces, water and lava.
bullets: Tool tiers, durability, new ores, hunger, armor and experience
Furnaces and smelting, with experience when you take the result
Flowing water and lava, buckets, swimming and falling sand
entries.body: The Survival Update is here. Tools now have tiers and durability, and blocks need the right tool to drop. New ores: copper, lapis, redstone and emerald. Hunger, damage, air and death work at Java Edition's numbers, with a death screen and respawning at your bed. Armor protects you, wears down and shows on your player. Build a furnace to smelt ores and food, and collect experience when you take the result. Water and lava flow, mix into cobblestone, stone and obsidian, and can be carried in buckets. You can swim and sprint-swim, sand and gravel fall, and new particles and HUD bars round it out. The Game Menu pauses singleplayer, while inventories and containers keep the world running. Worlds from 0.1.0 open in 0.2.0 and are backed up automatically the first time. Known issue: the new sounds are placeholders and will be replaced in a later update.

entries.title: Launcher 1.1.0: a new look
entries.body: The Blockcraft Launcher now matches the game's new Blockcraft theme. Every screen and dialog uses square pixel panels with crisp borders, beveled green, slate and red buttons, a big pixel PLAY button and the Pixelify Sans and Silkscreen pixel fonts. The header has the new BLOCKCRAFT wordmark, the sidebar has pixel icons, and the Play page shows the selected installation over the artwork with the latest news beside it. The light theme is restyled to match. Everything works as before; the launcher updates itself to 1.1.0 the next time it starts online.

entries.title: Snapshot 26w43a
entries.body: The first snapshot of the Survival Update (0.2.0). Tools now have tiers and durability (wood 59, stone 131, iron 250, gold 32, diamond 1561), blocks need the right tool to drop, and ores drop raw iron, raw gold and raw copper. New ores: copper, lapis, redstone and emerald. Hoes, buckets and all armor pieces exist (armor and buckets start working in later snapshots). Menus no longer pause the world. Worlds now remember the version they were last played in and warn before opening in an older one. Snapshots can damage your world: the first time a 0.1.0 world opens it is backed up automatically, but do not open snapshot worlds in 0.1.0.

entries.title: Welcome to Blockcraft
entries.body: Blockcraft is an original voxel sandbox. Build, explore and survive. This news feed is read by the Blockcraft Launcher from news.json next to the version manifest.
